name: enable_module
label: Enable Module
help_text: When off, the module outputs nothing. Use to keep the module in the page flow but hide it from view.

name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Replaces the auto-generated module ID used in HTML and for CSS/JS targeting. Leave blank to use the default.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Additional CSS classes for styling this module.

name: top_heading_items
label: Headings (above pillar)
help_text: Optional headings that appear above both columns, before the image and content row.

children.name: heading_text

children.help_text: Main heading text. Plain text or raw HTML tags (e.g. strong, em, span).
children.default: Add your Heading At The Top Here

children.name: heading_size

children.help_text: HTML heading level (h1–h6). Use Display Size to control how large it looks.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Controls how large the heading appears. Independent of the HTML heading level (Size).

children.name: heading_color

children.help_text: Theme or custom color for this heading. Auto inherits from context.

children.name: heading_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Color is set to Custom.

children.name: heading_align
children.label: Align
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment of the heading from 992px and up. Auto inherits from section or theme. Use Override Text Alignment (Tablet/Mobile) to set alignment for smaller screens.

children.name: heading_md_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_md_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: heading_md_display_size_override
children.label: Override Tablet Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_display_size_override
children.label: Override Mobile Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_padding_override
children.label: Override Padding
children.help_text: Enable to override the theme's default padding for this heading. When enabled, you can set custom top and bottom padding values. When disabled, padding is controlled by the theme's display size setting.

children.name: heading_class
children.label: CSS Class
children.help_text: Additional CSS class(es) for this element. Space-separated.

children.name: heading_items
children.label: Headings (above content)
children.help_text: Headings that appear inside the content column, above the content area.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Size that the heading is displayed at

children.name: heading_align

children.name: heading_padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Top padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Bottom padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_class
children.label: CSS Class
children.help_text: Additional CSS class(es) for this element. Space-separated.

children.name: bullet_items
children.label: Bullets
children.help_text: List items shown above the content area. Use Style tab to set list type (numbered or bullet) and default icon.

children.name: override_bullet
children.label: Override bullet
children.help_text: Use a different icon or image for this item when list type is Custom Icon or Custom Image.

children.name: item_bullet_type
children.label: Item bullet type
children.help_text: Choose whether to use a Font Awesome icon or a custom image for this item's bullet.

children.name: item_icon_purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: Decorative adds aria-hidden for screen readers.

children.name: item_icon_color
children.label: Item icon color
children.help_text: Leave empty to inherit text color. Only applies when Override bullet is on and an icon is set.

children.name: item_image
children.label: Item image
children.help_text: Custom image used as the bullet marker for this item (when item bullet type is Image).

children.name: section_text
children.label: Content Area
children.help_text: Main content of the module. Note: If you add text-align styles directly in the content editor (inline styles), those will override the responsive text alignment controls in the Style tab.
children.default: Add your main content here. This area supports rich text, headings, lists, and more.

children.name: content_style
children.label: Content style
children.help_text: Large = larger intro text (balanced or full-width); Small = smaller/secondary; Blockquote = quote/callout.

children.name: cta_button_items
children.label: Buttons
children.help_text: Add one or more buttons. Turn Disable Legacy Buttons ON to display these when legacy buttons exist.

children.name: add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

children.name: cta_alignment
children.label: Button Alignment
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment of the CTA buttons (left, center, or right).

children.name: cta_horizontal_align_md_override
children.label: Override Tablet Alignment
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom alignment for this breakpoint. When disabled, alignment is inherited from desktop.

children.name: cta_horizontal_align_md
children.label: Tablet Button Alignment
children.help_text: Alignment for this breakpoint. Leave as 'Auto' to inherit from desktop alignment.

children.name: cta_horizontal_align_sm_override
children.label: Override Mobile Alignment
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom alignment for this breakpoint. When disabled, alignment is inherited from desktop.

children.name: cta_horizontal_align_sm
children.label: Mobile Button Alignment
children.help_text: Alignment for this breakpoint when override is enabled. Leave as 'Auto' to use the base alignment.

children.name: cta_disable_legacy_buttons
children.label: Disable Legacy Buttons
children.help_text: Turn ON to display repeater buttons instead of legacy. When OFF and legacy exists, only legacy shows (repeater items are editable but not visible on the page). Add equivalent buttons in the repeater before turning ON.

children.name: button_1_add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

children.name: button_2_add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

name: gallery_items
label: Gallery Items
help_text: Add images or videos to the gallery. Each item can be an image or a video. When more than one item is added, thumbnails and navigation arrows appear.

children.name: media_type
children.label: Media Type
children.help_text: Choose Image or Video for this gallery item.

children.name: image
children.label: Image
children.help_text: Image for this gallery item. Used when Media Type is Image.

children.name: video_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot video, a video from the File Manager, or an external embed (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager.

children.name: video_poster
children.label: Video Poster Image
children.help_text: Optional poster image shown before the video plays. Also used as thumbnail when multiple items.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Set Background Option to Video in the Style tab first, then choose the video source (file, HubSpot video, or embed) and poster image here. Overlay and base color for video are in the Style tab when Video is selected.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop.

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.

children.name: module_settings
children.label: Module Settings
children.help_text: Module height, vertical alignment, and spacing. Height cascades from XL unless overridden. Pillar-specific: column alignment and bottom divider.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Adjust margins and padding for the module wrapper. Margin creates space between modules; padding creates space around the module content. When no padding is set, use no padding (do not default to 25px). When the module has multiple spacing fields (e.g. Text Box Padding), each applies to its intended target only — see MODULE-SETTINGS-BACKGROUND-STANDARD §1.

children.name: max_module_width
children.label: Max Module Width
children.help_text: Default, Small, Large: Use values from Global theme styles > Containers. Full Width: Content spans the full screen. Custom: Enter a specific pixel value (600–2400).

children.name: max_module_width_custom
children.label: Max Module Width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width in pixels when Custom is selected above.

children.name: module_height_xl_group
children.label: XL Module Height
children.help_text: Height settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: module_height_xl_mode
children.label: Minimum Height
children.help_text: Default: no minimum height (content dictates height). Custom Height: set a pixel value. Full Screen: 100vh minus header.

children.name: module_height_xl
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels. Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: vertical_align_xl
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment of content within the module at XL breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg_group
children.label: Override Desktop Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for 992px–1199px (LG). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_lg_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_lg
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses XL value.

children.name: module_height_md_group
children.label: Override Tablet Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for 768px–991px (MD). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_md_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_md
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_md
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: module_height_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_sm_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_sm
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_sm
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: column_vertical_align
children.label: Column Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: How the image/video and content columns align vertically within the section. Applies when the module has two columns.

children.name: bottom_divider
children.label: Bottom Divider
children.help_text: For space above divider, adjust the bottom padding. For space below divider, adjust the bottom margin.

children.name: divider_thickness
children.label: Divider Thickness
children.help_text: Line thickness in pixels. Only applies when Bottom Divider is enabled.

children.name: divider_width_percent
children.label: Divider Width (%)
children.help_text: Width of the line as a percentage of the section. Only applies when Bottom Divider is enabled.

children.name: divider_color
children.label: Divider Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme primary color. Only applies when Bottom Divider is enabled.

children.name: divider_style
children.label: Divider Line Style
children.help_text: Only applies when Bottom Divider is enabled.

children.name: module_background_settings
children.label: Module Background Settings
children.help_text: Configure the module background: Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, Image, or Video. All background styling (colors, gradient, image, and for Video the overlay and base color) is in this Style tab. When Video is selected, choose the video source only in the Content tab (Module Background Video).

children.name: background_option
children.label: Background Option
children.help_text: Choose the type of background: Theme Color, Custom Color (hex with opacity), Gradient, Image, or Video. When Video is selected, overlay and base color appear here; choose the video source and poster in the Content tab under Module Background Video.

children.name: background_color_overlay_video
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the video. Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: background_base_color_video
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the video (fallback or before video loads). Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: video_autoplay
children.label: Autoplay
children.help_text: Start playing when the page loads (recommended for background video).

children.name: video_loop
children.label: Loop
children.help_text: Restart the video when it ends.

children.name: video_muted
children.label: Muted
children.help_text: Play without sound (required for autoplay in most browsers).

children.name: video_plays_inline
children.label: Plays inline
children.help_text: Play inline on mobile instead of fullscreen.

children.name: background_image_xl_group
children.label: XL Background Image
children.help_text: Background image settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: background_image_xl
children.label: Background Image
children.help_text: Fallback image for smaller breakpoints if not overridden. For retina quality: use 2× the display width (about 2400px at 1200px). Height can match your section—from very short to several hundred pixels—and Background Position helps with focal point.

children.name: background_position_xl
children.label: Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_xl
children.label: Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_xl
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image to adjust contrast for text.

children.name: background_base_color_xl
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image (fallback or for transparent areas).

children.name: background_image_lg_group
children.label: Override Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 992px–1199px (LG). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_lg_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_md_group
children.label: Override Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 768px–991px (MD). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_md_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_md
children.label: Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_md
children.label: Tablet Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_md
children.label: Tablet Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_md
children.label: Tablet Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_md
children.label: Tablet Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_sm_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: background_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Theme Color is set to Custom.

children.name: background_custom
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Solid color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: background_gradient
children.label: Background Gradient
children.help_text: Gradient colors and direction when Background Option is Gradient.

children.name: content_colors
children.label: Content Colors
children.help_text: Content Area text and link colors. Use when background is image/gradient/custom and theme defaults do not apply correctly. Does not apply to headings—they have their own color settings.

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Theme defaults uses cascade. Choose a theme color or Custom for a hex color when content sits on image/gradient/custom backgrounds.

children.name: text_color_custom
children.label: Custom Text Color
children.help_text: Hex color when Text Color is Custom.

children.name: link_context
children.label: Link Colors
children.help_text: When links are on a dark background, choose Dark. When on light background, choose Light. Required when Text Color is Custom since cascade cannot infer it.

children.name: Column_Width_Setting
children.label: Column Width Settings
children.help_text: Controls the width of the secondary column. Main content fills the remaining space. 12 columns = stacked on all screens.

children.name: secondary_cols_lg
children.label: Desktop Column Width
children.help_text: Controls the secondary column width on desktop. Main content fills the rest. 12 = stacked.

children.name: secondary_cols_md
children.label: Tablet Column Width
children.help_text: Controls the secondary column width on tablet. Select Inherit to use Desktop Column Width.

children.name: Pillar_Image_Setting
children.label: Secondary (Gallery) Settings
children.help_text: Layout and options for the gallery column. Column order, media corner radius, gallery position, navigation arrows, autoplay, and thumbnail strip.

children.name: desktop_image_position
children.label: Desktop Column Order
children.help_text: Which column appears on the left (or on top when stacked at 12 cols). Secondary Column on Left/Top = secondary on left/top; Secondary Column on Right/Bottom = main content on left/top.

children.name: tablet_image_position
children.label: Tablet Column Order
children.help_text: Which column appears on the left (or on top when stacked at 12 cols). Select Inherit to use Desktop Column Order.

children.name: mobile_image_position
children.label: Mobile Column Order
children.help_text: Which column appears on top. Secondary Column on Top = secondary on top; Secondary Column on Bottom = main content on top.

children.name: override_image_border_radius
children.label: Override Media Border Radius
children.help_text: When enabled, use the custom corner radius below (Image or Video depending on secondary column type). When disabled, use the Global Border Radius from theme settings. Applies to both images and videos.

children.name: image_border_radius
children.label: Image Corner Radius
children.help_text: Rounds the corners of the image. Set to 0 for no border radius.

children.name: video_border_radius
children.label: Video Corner Radius
children.help_text: Rounds the corners of the video. Set to 0 for no border radius.

children.name: gallery_position
children.label: Gallery Position
children.help_text: Which side of the primary (text) column the gallery appears on.

children.name: gallery_settings
children.label: Gallery Settings
children.help_text: Navigation arrows and autoplay options. Only applies when there are 2 or more gallery items.

children.name: prev_arrow_type
children.label: Previous Arrow
children.help_text: Choose Font Awesome icon or custom uploaded image for the previous/left arrow.

children.name: prev_arrow_image
children.label: Previous Arrow Image
children.help_text: Custom image for the previous arrow. Used when Previous Arrow is set to Custom Image.

children.name: next_arrow_type
children.label: Next Arrow
children.help_text: Choose Font Awesome icon or custom uploaded image for the next/right arrow.

children.name: next_arrow_image
children.label: Next Arrow Image
children.help_text: Custom image for the next arrow. Used when Next Arrow is set to Custom Image.

children.name: autoplay_enabled
children.label: Enable Autoplay
children.help_text: Automatically advance to the next gallery item after the delay. Only applies when there are 2+ items.

children.name: autoplay_delay
children.label: Autoplay Delay (seconds)
children.help_text: Seconds between automatic advances. Only applies when Autoplay is enabled.

children.name: video_autoplay
children.label: Video Autoplay (first item only)
children.help_text: When the first gallery item is a video and it is visible on page load, autoplay that video. Videos in other positions never autoplay.

children.name: gallery_thumbnail_settings
children.label: Thumbnail Strip Position
children.help_text: Controls where the thumbnail strip appears. XS/SM: always below main image, horizontal. MD: below by default, optional left. LG/XL: always left, vertical.

children.name: thumbnails_per_row_xs_sm
children.label: Thumbnails Per Row (XS/SM)
children.help_text: Number of thumbnails per row when strip is below main image. Breakpoints: ≤767px (SM), ≤575px (XS).

children.name: thumbnail_position_md
children.label: Tablet Position
children.help_text: Thumbnail strip position on tablet. Below = horizontal strip under main image. Left = vertical strip to the left of main image.

children.name: Content_Area_Setting
children.label: Content Settings
children.help_text: Text alignment for the main content area and secondary content area (when Secondary Column is set to Content).
children.inline_help_text: Main content and secondary content (when Secondary Column is Content).

children.name: text_align_default
children.label: Text Alignment
children.help_text: Default text alignment for all screen sizes. Can be overridden for tablet and mobile.

children.name: override_md_text_align
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_md
children.label: Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: override_sm_text_align
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_sm
children.label: Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: list_type
children.label: List Type
children.help_text: Numbered (ol), Bullet (ul with disc), Custom Icon (Font Awesome), or Custom Image.

children.name: default_bullet_image
children.label: Default bullet image
children.help_text: Custom image used as the bullet marker for all list items.

children.name: default_bullet_icon_purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: Decorative adds aria-hidden for screen readers.

children.name: bullet_font_size
children.label: Bullet list font size
children.help_text: Applies to all list items (numbered and bullet).

children.name: list_item_bottom_spacing
children.label: List item bottom spacing
children.help_text: Bottom padding for each list item (spacing between items).

children.name: list_left_padding
children.label: List left padding
children.help_text: Left padding of the list. Set to 0 for flush against the container.
